entries.title: C0017: square-bond Cardy and SLE6 target (current status unknown)
entries.statement: Historical target: for independent nearest-neighbor bond percolation on mesh-delta Z^2 at p=1/2, establish Cardy's conformally invariant limit for open crossings of marked Jordan domains as delta tends to zero, and convergence of critical Dobrushin exploration interfaces to chordal SLE_6. Garban-Steif's 2012 preprint called the square-lattice conformal-invariance problem open; later proof-claim preprints exist, so current openness is UNKNOWN until those proofs are audited.
assumptions: A specified lattice approximation and marked Jordan-domain boundary arcs
Dobrushin boundary conditions for the separate interface component

source.excerpt: on Z^2 at p_c = 1/2, proving the conformal invariance

entries.title: Smirnov FK-Ising parafermion limit, q=2
entries.statement: Let mesh-delta_j square-lattice Dobrushin domains (Omega_j,a_j,b_j) converge in the Caratheodory sense to a simply connected marked domain (Omega,a,b), with delta_j tending to zero. In the critical FK-Ising random-cluster model q=2 and p=sqrt(2)/(1+sqrt(2)), let F_j be Smirnov's parafermionic observable of spin sigma=1/2. Then delta_j^(-1/2) F_j converges uniformly on compact subsets away from the boundary to (Phi')^(1/2), where Phi maps Omega conformally to a horizontal strip of width 2 and sends a,b to its ends. This theorem has q=2 and an observable conclusion; it does not directly establish the independent square-bond q=1 target.
entries.proof_text: Smirnov proves Ising-specific discrete analyticity and boundary conditions for F_j, obtains compactness and convergence of a discrete primitive of F_j squared to Im Phi using harmonic estimates, then identifies every subsequential limit by the boundary value problem and normalization. The q=2 discrete analyticity and estimates are essential in the source proof.

source.excerpt: Then for the Ising model the corresponding functions F_j converge uniformly away from the boundary

entries.title: Critical FK parafermionic weak contour relation
entries.statement: In a finite square-lattice FK random-cluster Dobrushin domain at the critical self-dual parameter, for 0<q<4 define the medial-edge parafermionic observable F(e)=E[exp(i sigma W_gamma(e,e_b)) 1_{e in gamma}], where sin(pi sigma/2)=sqrt(q)/2 and sigma is in (0,1). At every interior medial vertex with incident edges NW,SE,NE,SW, F(NW)-F(SE)=i(F(NE)-F(SW)). At q=1, sigma=1/3. This one local relation alone does not identify a holomorphic continuum limit.
entries.proof_text: Pair configurations by toggling the primal edge corresponding to the medial vertex. At the critical self-dual edge weight, the paired probabilities and the change in interface winding make the NW-SE and i times NE-SW contributions equal; summing over each involution pair yields the stated identity. This is Duminil-Copin Proposition 4's local proof mechanism.

relations.rationale: Source theorem ends at q=2 FK-Ising and (Phi')^(1/2); target begins at q=1 independent bonds and Cardy/SLE6. Exact model and conclusion mismatch makes this an analogy, not a proof or generalization.
Local-relation card explicitly includes q=1 spin 1/3 and a contour identity; target asks for square-bond Cardy/SLE6. The identity is a relevant ingredient whose scaling-limit bridge is absent.
